recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-29559 unless a future work group decision changes Task status semantics; leave FHIR-29558 to the Da Vinci HRex context where it was already published.
issue_request: FHIR-29559 was an Applied FHIR-core Task change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification, asking to reword Task.status code failed so it no longer implied failure was non-terminal or limited to a specific error cause. The approved wording was: "The task was attempted but was not successful.  No further activity will occur for this task."
initial_application: Core history already applied the change: f7c6723b991050b0bdb5820631a139832210b12b changed source/task/codesystem-task-status.xml from the old R4 definition to the approved wording, and 02351d5e1bf08c2ff0035279b9a1c80898baeff6 cleaned whitespace in the same file. The Jira comment points to merge-history commit 535329c6d76de15b06e3d3d845d0f72ab7a2081f, but the direct source hunk is f7c6723b99.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini includes an active task=Task resource entry, so the Task source files are in current build scope. The current CodeSystem source exactly matches the approved definition, searches found no remaining obsolete failed-status wording in the active Task or core CodeSystem source, and targeted Zulip searches found no conflicting discussion. Confluence minutes are consistent with Jira: FHIR Workflow recommended Persuasive with Modification in 2021 and OO approved the 2024 block vote containing FHIR-29559. FHIR-29558 is related background from the Da Vinci HRex IG, not a FHIR-core issue to publish here.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch because the authoritative current source is already correct and no source edit is needed.
